story_arc.summary: Scenario character of 'Hashire! Mecha Umamusume -Yume Tsunagu Hatsumei-' (JP, Oct 29 2024). She is the inventor of the full-dive robot ST-2 and seeks Tracen assistants to complete it; she is not playable and cannot be trained due to her condition. She is not based on a real racehorse.
